## Activity

East City Eye Clinic recorded 222 captures during March 2026. Activity proceeded in line with the expected service arrangements for the month. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. The available activity indicates that the clinic continued to provide a consistent pathway for image capture and onward grading. No operational disruption was identified in the information reviewed.

## Image quality

Of the 222 captures, 4 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 1.8 per cent. The proportion of images that could not be assessed remained limited in relation to overall activity. These captures should continue to be monitored through routine quality review so that any recurring issues can be identified and addressed through normal service processes.

## Grading

There were 68 referable results during March 2026. The median grading wait was 2 days. This provides an overall view of grading timeliness for the reporting period and should be considered alongside the activity and image-quality findings. Continued monitoring of referral outcomes and grading waits will support routine oversight of the clinic’s performance.
